one_liner_zh: 美光受惠於強勁AI需求，營收與獲利大幅優於市場預期。
one_liner_en: Micron reported explosive revenue and EPS growth, significantly beating consensus estimates driven by robust AI demand.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：每股盈餘實際值 25.11 美元顯著高於預期的 20.69 美元，驚喜幅度達 21.39%。
highlights_zh: 季度營收達 414.6 億美元，年增率高達 345.72%。
每股盈餘（EPS）繳出 25.11 美元的亮眼成績。
受惠於 AI 基礎設施擴建，高頻寬記憶體（HBM）與資料中心產品需求極度強勁。
highlights_en: Quarterly revenue reached $41.46B, representing a massive 345.72% YoY growth.
EPS came in strong at $25.11, outperforming expectations.
Extreme demand for High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) and data center solutions fueled by AI infrastructure buildout.
risks_zh: 總體經濟波動可能影響消費性電子產品的記憶體需求復甦。
產能擴張速度若不及需求成長，可能面臨供應鏈瓶頸。
risks_en: Macroeconomic volatility could weigh on the recovery of memory demand in consumer electronics.
Potential supply chain bottlenecks if capacity expansion lags behind robust demand.
ai_view_zh: 觀點：財報展現強勁的AI變現能力與定價優勢，對中短期股價具強烈正面訊號。後續應追蹤HBM產能擴充進度、毛利率走勢及終端需求續航力。
ai_view_en: view: The earnings demonstrate robust AI monetization and pricing power, providing a strong positive signal for near-to-mid-term stock performance. Track HBM capacity expansion, gross margin trajectory, and end-market demand sustainability.
